raw_metric_improvement.note: The 0.34 score is unchanged from v1 because the scoring formula saturates any deviation beyond 50% to the same minimum contribution. The underlying RMSE values improved substantially between v1 and v2 and should not be considered 'no progress'.

notes: v2 comparison follows a code fix (obs_noise_std threading) and extended training (50->300 epochs) for the latent ODE experiment only; classification results are unchanged/not rerun. All three latent-ODE runs (n_obs=30/50/100) were still improving at epoch 299 (not converged), so v2 values should be treated as a progress checkpoint. A new anomaly was identified: RMSE does not follow the paper's expected monotonic improvement with more observations (n_obs=30 outperforms n_obs=100, which outperforms n_obs=50) -- likely due to un-seeded train/test splits across separate runs and/or differing convergence state at the shared epoch-299 cutoff. See hallucination_report.md and benchmark_comparison.md for full detail and recommended next steps.
